# provenance.architecture: DenseNet121 growth 32, block depths 6/12/24/16; spatial_dims=3 is the MONAI adaptation of the original 2D architecture.
# provenance.optimizer_schedule: DenseNet section 4.2: Nesterov SGD momentum 0.9, weight decay 1e-4, 90 epochs, tenfold reductions at epochs 30/60.
# provenance.learning_rate: 0.01 is project-adapted from paper ImageNet 0.1; small volumetric batch does not justify claiming the original rate is optimal. Grid exposes 0.003/0.01/0.03.
# provenance.early_stopping: Disabled for publication schedule so the 30/60 epoch milestones are actually reached; select best validation checkpoint within the full 90-epoch budget.
# provenance.geometry: Med3D training-median spacing and nnU-Net geometry/memory planning principles. Max-extent coarsening to a 256-cube is a task adaptation. Validation/test keep fitted spacing unchanged; larger scans expand the padded canvas.
# provenance.intensity: Med3D LiTS [-200,250] HU precedent; mapping to [0,1] and use for five-class/DenseNet classification are adaptations.
# provenance.imbalance: Effective-number weighted CE (Cui et al. CVPR 2019); beta=0.999 from existing systematic adapters, computed on fold training labels only.
# provenance.batch_precision: Effective batch 4, default microbatch 4, BF16/FP32 execution are measured resource adaptations; accumulation does not make BatchNorm batch sizes equivalent.
# provenance.augmentation: None: preserve laterality and coverage without lesion boxes. Not the original papers augmentation recipe.
# provenance.selection: Existing systematic score 0.7 macro-F1 + 0.3 balanced accuracy; five-fold grid uses mean-minus-SD. Refit uses median selected optimizer step, so full-development refit has fewer epoch equivalents than CV.
